title: Foundation Stone
body:
Chiseled into the stone at the outpost's heart:

"We built this to outlast us. Maybe it still can. Maybe you will."

title: A Torn Ledger
body:
Columns of stores, every number crossed lower than the last. The final entry is hurried:

"The cold came in the eighth week, not the twelfth. We voted tonight. We go at first light. Forgive us the things we leave."

title: A Child's Drawing
body:
A crayon sun over stick figures and a square house. On the back, in an adult's careful hand:

"For when we come back."

title: An Unsent Letter
body:
Weighed down by a cold chisel beside the forge:

"I won't leave the fire to die. If the marsh wakes again, someone should be here to turn the next ones back. Tell them I stayed on purpose. — P"

title: A Stake and a Rag
body:
A leaning stake at the world's cold edge, a grey rag knotted to it. Words gouged deep:

"PAST HERE IT DOESN'T SLEEP. TURN BACK."
